```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidytable)
library(scales)
library(flextable)
load("data_report_2026test_13okt2026.RData")


#Specify until which year
year_of_interest_test <- 2025
year_of_interest_diagn <- 2025

```

## Fig 1 Reimbursed tests - Belgium
```{r Fig Tests BE, echo=FALSE}
FIG <- Coverage %>%
  dplyr::filter( Gender == "All" & Region == "BEL" & Year <= year_of_interest_test)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  left_join(
    BelgianPop_STI %>% 
      dplyr::filter(Age == "All"),
    by = c("Year", "Region", "Gender")
  )%>%
  mutate( test_pop = (NTests_all / Population) *1000)%>%
  arrange(Germ, Region, Year) %>%
    group_by(Germ, Region) %>%
    mutate(
      
      # Year-over-year percentage difference
      pct_diff_1_year = (test_pop - lag(test_pop)) / lag(test_pop),
      
      # Difference between year_of_interest_test and 2016 (only shown on year_of_interest_test row)
      pct_diff_vs_2016 = if_else(
        Year == year_of_interest_test,
        (test_pop - first(test_pop[Year == 2016])) /
          first(test_pop[Year == 2016]),
        NA_real_
      ),
      

      # Average yearly percentage difference between 2016 and year of interest
      # CAGR-style calculation
      avg_yearly_pct_diff_vs_2016 = if_else(
        Year == year_of_interest_test,
        (
          (test_pop / first(test_pop[Year == 2016]))^(1 / (year_of_interest_test - 2016)) - 1
        ),
        NA_real_
      )
      
    ) %>%
    ungroup()%>%
  select(-c(Gender, Region, NTests_epi, coverage, coverage_lag, coverage_trend, Age, Population))

pct_cols <- c("pct_diff_1_year", "pct_diff_vs_2016", "avg_yearly_pct_diff_vs_2016")

Tests_fig_fmt <- FIG %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::as_tibble() %>%  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(pct_cols),
      ~ percent(.x, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )

flextable(Tests_fig_fmt)
rm(FIG)
```

## Fig 5 Diagnostic trends - Belgium
```{r Fig  : Diagnostic trends - Belgium, echo=FALSE}
FIG <-AdjInc %>%
  filter(Gender == "All" & Region == "BEL" & Age == "All")%>%
   arrange(Germ, Year) %>%
  group_by(Germ, Region, Age)%>%
  mutate(
    # Year-over-year percentage difference
  pct_diff_1_year = (Inc_est - lag(Inc_est)) / lag(Inc_est),
  
  # Difference between year_of_interest_diagn and 2016 (only shown on year_of_interest_diagn row)
  pct_diff_vs_2016 = if_else(
    Year == year_of_interest_diagn,
    (Inc_est - first(Inc_est[Year == 2016])) /
      first(Inc_est[Year == 2016]),
    NA_real_
  ),
  
  # Average yearly percentage difference between 2016 and year_of_interest_diagn
  # CAGR-style calculation
  avg_yearly_pct_diff_vs_2016 = if_else(
    Year == year_of_interest_diagn,
    (
      (Inc_est / first(Inc_est[Year == 2016]))^(1 / (year_of_interest_diagn - 2016)) - 1
    ),
    NA_real_
  )) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  select(-c(NCases, coverage, NCases_corr, Population))

pct_cols <- c("pct_diff_1_year", "pct_diff_vs_2016", "avg_yearly_pct_diff_vs_2016")

Tests_fig_fmt <- FIG %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(pct_cols),
      ~ percent(as.numeric(.x), accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )

flextable(Tests_fig_fmt)
rm(FIG, Tests_fig_fmt, pct_cols)


```

## Fig 16 Chlamydia Test trends - by sex & age
```{r Fig Chlamydia test trends - by sex & age, echo=FALSE}
FIG <- tests_pop_age %>%
  filter(Germ == "CHLTRA" 
          & Region == "BEL"
          & Age_cat != "0-14")%>%

  select(Germ, Gender, Age_cat, year_prest, Bel_tests_pop_1k)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  arrange(Gender, Age_cat, year_prest) %>%
  group_by(Gender, Age_cat, Germ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Year-over-year percentage difference
      pct_diff_1_year = (Bel_tests_pop_1k - lag(Bel_tests_pop_1k)) / lag(Bel_tests_pop_1k),
      
      # Difference between year_of_interest_test and 2016 (only shown on year_of_interest_test row)
      pct_diff_vs_2016 = if_else(
        year_prest == year_of_interest_test,
        (Bel_tests_pop_1k - first(Bel_tests_pop_1k[year_prest == 2016])) /
          first(Bel_tests_pop_1k[year_prest == 2016]),
        NA_real_
      ),
      
      # Average yearly percentage difference between 2016 and 2024
      # CAGR-style calculation
      avg_yearly_pct_diff_vs_2016 = if_else(
        year_prest == year_of_interest_test,
        (
          (Bel_tests_pop_1k / first(Bel_tests_pop_1k[year_prest == 2016]))^(1 / (year_of_interest_test - 2016)) - 1
        ),
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
  ungroup()

pct_cols <- c("pct_diff_1_year", "pct_diff_vs_2016", "avg_yearly_pct_diff_vs_2016")

Tests_fig_fmt <- FIG %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(pct_cols),
      ~ percent(as.numeric(.x), accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )

flextable(Tests_fig_fmt)
rm(FIG, pct_cols, Tests_fig_fmt)
```


## Fig 17 Chlamydia Diagnostic trends - Belgium by sex & age 
``` {r Fig Chlamydia diagnostic trends - by sex & age, echo=FALSE}
FIG <- AdjInc_new_age %>%
  filter(Germ == "CHLTRA", Gender != "All" & Region == "BEL" & Age_cat_new != "All")%>%
  filter(Age_cat_new != "0-14")%>%
  distinct()%>%
  arrange(Germ, Gender, Age_cat_new, Year) %>%
  group_by(Germ, Gender, Age_cat_new)%>%
  mutate(
    
    # Year-over-year percentage difference
    pct_diff_1_year = (Inc_est_new - lag(Inc_est_new)) / lag(Inc_est_new),
    
    # Difference between year_of_interest_diagn and 2016 (only shown on year_of_interest_diagn row)
    pct_diff_vs_2016 = if_else(
      Year == year_of_interest_diagn,
      (Inc_est_new - first(Inc_est_new[Year == 2016])) /
        first(Inc_est_new[Year == 2016]),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Average yearly percentage difference between 2016 and year_of_interest_diagn
    # CAGR-style calculation
    avg_yearly_pct_diff_vs_2016 = if_else(
      Year == year_of_interest_diagn,
      (
        (Inc_est_new / first(Inc_est_new[Year == 2016]))^(1 / (year_of_interest_diagn - 2016)) - 1
      ),
      NA_real_
    )) %>%
  select(-c(NCases_new, Population_new, Cases_corr_new))
```
